DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH) due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency.

The combination of ambiguous genitalia at birth (partial labial fusion, clitoromegaly), virilization in childhood (maternal hirsutism, severe acne), delayed puberty, and osteoporosis (fractures) strongly suggests this diagnosis. Can you confirm if you have had any previous adrenal insufficiency crises or electrolyte imbalances?
